requirements.snippet_text: FOREX Note : Exchange column for FOREX instruments should be empty On UI 'Instrument type' filter suggests and displays 'FX Spot' 5.2 Instrument suggestion search It should be possible to search instrument by the following instrument fields via entering at least one symbol: Symbol Description ISIN (searchable, but not shown) 5.3 Derivatives (Option Chain) & Risk Profile 5.3.1 Derivatives (Option Chain) Derivatives (Option Chain) widget should be shown if one of the conditions is satisfied: options are available on at least one account in the portfolio ( ) + Option Level is >0 on this account ( ) futures are available on at least one account in the portfolio ( ) If there are multiple portfolios visible for the User, the Derivatives widget should be shown if it's available for at least one of the portfolios. The widget represents a tool to trade derivatives such as Options and Futures based on the selected underlying. The widget contains 2 sections: Underlying Instruments (with position info) table Option Chain based on underlying instruments Underlying Instruments in the table are shown based on the type of selected instrument in the header of the widget: If an instrument with type other than PRODUCT is selected, then only selected instrument is shown in the table, options in the option chain section are shown based on this instrument. If an instrument with type PRODUCT is selected, then the table should contain the instruments with the following types: FUTURE instruments related to the selected product; SPREAD instruments (future spreads) related to the selected product. If the selected PRODUCT instrument has OPOL that supports only single futures according to the configuration , then SPREAD instruments should be hidden. Bid and Ask columns in the Underlying Instruments section are clickable buttons, and on hover Sell and Buy tooltips are shown. After clicking Sell or Buy an order entry with the selected instrument (underlying) and Side is opened. For the instruments with type SPREAD multileg order entry should be opened with pre-selected Futures in each leg according to the formula of the selected symbol ( ). Spread - only Fut Calendar spread is supported in ph2: Spread Name Number of legs Description Related SPREAD instrument Ratio Single
